purpose: exploratory TED selection control using nonoverlapping metadata validation blocks
arms: best current-domain selection-block foreground micro Dice, ties earliest
initialization: fresh random per seed, no pretrained segmentation model
training: site1 then site2, 20 epochs per task, batch8; same original project inputs, labels, model, optimizer and objectives; restore selected network and BN before teacher creation
validation: at each site first metadata-defined inclusive boundary block for selection; second disjoint block only for held-out evaluation after task2; exact metadata provenance unconfirmed; each set contains one block per site; no patient-independent assertion
qualification: all four arms rc0 finite; mean gain over two sites and two seeds >=0.03, each seed mean positive and no site mean decrease >0.02; pass permits prespecified six-domain validation follow-up only
limitations: two seeds and one block per group/site; unverified patient independence; authors' ScoreDice and exact restore semantics not verified; GPU arithmetic not bitwise paired; exploratory, not unbiased final test
stop: nonfinite loss, logits, parameters, optimizer or validation, loss >10000, any arm failure, deadline or disk cap; no retries
